title: PH to acquire US military equipment 'not sold to other countries' under $2-B financing – Teodoro
summary: The Philippines will acquire United States military equipment that are not made available for sale to other countries under a $2-billion financing package, Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. said…

blocks.text: The Philippines will acquire United States military equipment that are not made available for sale to other countries under a $2-billion financing package, Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. said on Tuesday.
